    Local endomorphism rings of finite-dimensional linear modules #

    The category of finite-support pointwise finite-dimensional linear functors is closed under retracts inside the ambient functor category. It is therefore idempotent-complete. Evaluation on the finite support embeds each endomorphism space into a finite product of finite-dimensional pointwise endomorphism spaces. Hence an indecomposable object has local endomorphism ring by the generic finite-dimensional Fitting criterion.
